shortDescription: Maps consumer guarantees, marketing, merger notification, competition conduct and product safety for lawyer review.
longDescription: Seven practitioner-led workflows with controlled profiles, point-in-time official-source checks, separate current and future reforms, merger threshold and waiver pathways, urgent safety escalation and an on-demand ACCC watch register. Every conclusion requires qualified lawyer review.

whatItDoes: Assesses guarantees, remedies and warranty documents
Reviews environmental, comparative and pricing claims
Maps merger thresholds, waivers and standstill issues
Separates cartel, RPM, exclusive dealing and market power risks
Maps product safety instruments and reporting candidates
Checks developments against official sources on demand
boundaries: Qualified lawyer review required; no compliance certification
No filing, publication, recall execution, competitor contact or acquisition completion
Snapshot sources require verification at use; proposals are not obligations

requires.australian-legal-research: Verifies legislation, instruments, commencement and case-law leads at official publishers.

handsOffTo.australian-employment-fair-work: Reuses controlled profile approval and versioning patterns without importing coverage conclusions.
handsOffTo.australian-commercial-drafting: Reuses the UCT checklist, UTPA 2026 notes and operative website/services drafting.
handsOffTo.australian-privacy-cybersecurity: Assesses advertising data, decision transparency and safety-incident privacy issues.
